title: Energy-Efficient Satellite Wake-Up via Bosonic Identification: The Role of Synchronization
summary: The information-theoretic concept of identification describes a sender-receiver architecture in which the receiver only checks whether a particular message was sent or not, thereby promising a low-energy receiver design. In low received-energy regimes, quantum receivers are a promising tool for studying the system limits. However, the known information-theoretically optimal identification codes typically assume perfect synchronization.
